observed_state.description: Deposited processed-chain pyruvoyl component PYR at chain F label position 1 and author residue 82, covalently connected to Phe author residue 83; no free-ligand ChEBI identity or protonation is assigned.

claim.statement: The current 1PYA structure record models an N-terminal PYR component at processed chain-F label position 1 and PDB author residue 82, covalently connected to Phe author residue 83. This supports the deposited processed pyruvoyl state without treating precursor cleavage as a structure-observed mechanism or asserting a canonical sequence mapping in the v1 annotation.

evidence.citation: Gallagher, Rozwarski, Ernst and Hackert (1993), PDB 1PYA; DOI 10.2210/pdb1PYA/pdb; PMID 8464063. PDB archive data: CC0 1.0.
evidence.experimental_context: Current revision 2.1, X-ray diffraction at 2.5 A. Chain F entity 2 begins with deposited PYR label 1/author 82, covalently connected to Phe label 2/author 83. The only deposited nonpolymer/solvent component is water. Native or wild-type status is not asserted.

evidence.citation: Huynh, Recsei, Vaaler and Snell (1984), J Biol Chem 259, 2833-2839; PMID 6698997.
evidence.experimental_context: The inspected PubMed abstract reports proenzyme activation cleavage at the historical Ser81-Ser82 bond. It does not identify Ser82 as the pyruvoyl precursor and is not used to assert the current canonical mapping. The response body is local-analysis-only.

evidence.citation: Gallagher, Rozwarski, Ernst and Hackert (1993), J Mol Biol 230, 516-528; DOI 10.1006/jmbi.1993.1168; PMID 8464063.
evidence.experimental_context: The inspected PubMed abstract assigns alpha/beta-chain formation and pyruvoyl generation to autocatalytic cleavage between two serines. The structure supports the processed product state, not a directly observed cleavage trajectory. The response body is local-analysis-only.

evidence.citation: wwPDB versioned archive, 1PYA revision 1.3 (2017-11-29); DOI 10.2210/pdb1PYA/pdb. PDB archive data: CC0 1.0.
evidence.experimental_context: The pre-major-revision archive contains chain-F PYR label 1/author 82 and the same coordinates. It corroborates persistence across revisions but is not established as the exact coordinate byte stream used in the 1993 analysis.

limits.statement: The structure shows the processed pyruvoyl state. It does not directly observe precursor cleavage, maturation atom edits, catalytic ordering, rate, or timing.
Current canonical P00862 Ser83, the PMID 6698997 Ser81-Ser82 cleavage bond, M-CSA Prv-82, PDB author PYR82, and processed-chain label/Pyr1F remain distinct statements or numbering namespaces.
The deposited _struct_ref_seq row starts at standard residue label 2 and excludes label-1 PYR; it cannot independently ground the modified-site mapping.

The audit projection retains the current UniProt P00862 Ser83 annotation, but primary-evidence v1 has no curated-protein evidence kind. The v1 annotation therefore leaves sequence_mapping not_asserted.
1PYA has no bound substrate or analogue and does not resolve the preserved M-CSA entry CHEBI:57595 versus MRV CHEBI:32526 conflict.
The observed component is pyruvoyl; no PLP identity or PLP-equivalent state is asserted.
The deposited mutation field is unspecified. Native or wild-type status is not asserted.

Revision 1.3 corroborates the processed PYR observation before the 2023 major atomic-model revision. Neither archived revision 1.3 nor current revision 2.1 is claimed to be the exact coordinate file used for the 1993 publication.
